title: auri ops
description: The auri ops catalog for A2UI: agent dashboards, data display, and human-in-the-loop decisions. Component contract v1 — all 12 components: Stat, Badge, Callout, DataTable, ApprovalCard, Chart, Timeline, Sparkline, Progress, KeyValue, CodeBlock, ConfirmButton.
instructions: Rules for emitting this catalog. 1) Emit raw values: 12400, never "12,400" or "$12.4K" — the renderer formats numbers, dates and units in the user's locale. 2) `intent` judges, `trend` describes: latency rising is trend "up" with intent "bad"; error rate falling is trend "down" with intent "good". 3) One shared intent scale: good (healthy) | bad (failing) | warning (needs attention) | info (informational) | neutral (no judgment). Omit intent when you are not making a claim. 4) No icons, colors, or sizes on the wire — intent implies iconography and the theme decides the look. 5) Bind values you expect to change with {"path": "/json/pointer"} and update them via updateDataModel instead of re-sending components. 6) Layout containers (Row, Column, Card, List) come from the basic catalog: give those components an explicit "catalogId": "https://a2ui.org/specification/v1_0/catalogs/basic/catalog.json".

label.description: Short name of the metric, e.g. 'Error rate'. Required — it is also the tile's accessible name.

value.description: The current reading, raw and unformatted (a number like 12400, or a short string like 'Healthy'). Bind with {"path": ...} when it will update.

unit.description: Unit rendered beside the value: 'ms', '%', 'req/s', or an ISO 4217 currency code like 'USD' (currencies are formatted in the user's locale). Omit for unitless values.

delta.description: Signed change versus the comparison period, as a raw number (e.g. -38). The renderer formats the sign.

caption.description: One small line of context under the value, e.g. 'vs previous hour'.

trend.description: Direction of movement: 'up', 'down' or 'flat'. Describes, never judges — pair with intent for the judgment.

intent.description: Judgment of the current reading on the shared scale. Default: 'neutral'.

Stat.description: A KPI tile: one metric with its label, current value, and optionally its change, direction and judgment.

text.description: The chip's short text, e.g. 'Canary', 'Live', 'Degraded'. Required — it is the badge's accessible name. Keep it to a word or two.

intent.description: Judgment of the status on the shared scale. Default: 'neutral'.

Badge.description: A small status chip for a state or category, e.g. a deploy stage or a job status.

title.description: Optional short heading for the callout.

text.description: The callout body. Required. Supports inline markdown: **bold**, *italics*, `code`, [links](https://...).

intent.description: The callout's register on the shared scale. Default: 'info' — a callout exists to call attention; informational is its resting state.

Callout.description: An alert/note block the agent uses to tell the user something in prose: a heads-up, a caveat, a status note.

columns.description: Flat column descriptors; each names a key present in the row objects.

rows.description: The row objects. Bind with {"path": ...} so rows and individual cells can update via updateDataModel.

emptyText.description: Shown when rows resolves to an empty array. Keep it quiet and factual.

rowAction.description: Fired when the user activates a row. The renderer adds `row` (the row object) and `rowIndex` to the action context automatically.

DataTable.description: A data table bound to a collection in the data model. Columns are declared; rows live in data and update without re-sending the component.

title.description: The decision being asked, as a short question, e.g. "Roll back payments-api?".

summary.description: One or two sentences of context the human needs to decide. Inline markdown allowed.

details.description: Optional ComponentId of extra content rendered collapsed inside the card (any component, e.g. a DataTable of affected services).

approveAction.description: Fired on approve. Put only what you need to act on in the context — the decision payload, not the world.

rejectAction.description: Fired on reject. Same context discipline as approveAction.

requireComment.description: When true, the card requires a comment before either decision; the renderer adds `comment` (string) to the fired action's context.

approveLabel.description: Custom label for the approve button. Default is a localized "Approve".

rejectLabel.description: Custom label for the reject button. Default is a localized "Reject".

ApprovalCard.description: The agent asks a human to decide. Exactly two outcomes; both fire actions carrying hand-picked context. The card disables itself after a decision.

kind.description: The mark. Line for trends over time, bar for comparisons, area for cumulative feel.

label.description: The chart's title and accessible name, e.g. "Error rate by class". Required — a chart without a name is unreadable to assistive tech.

series.description: The data series. Bind each series' values with {"path": ...} so the chart streams.

xLabels.description: Labels along the x axis, one per data point. With xFormat 'datetime', supply ISO 8601 strings and the renderer formats them in the user's locale.

xFormat.description: How to interpret xLabels — same idea as a DataTable column format. 'datetime' expects ISO 8601 strings.

unit.description: Unit for the value axis: 'ms', '%', 'req/s', or an ISO 4217 currency code.

Chart.description: A line/bar/area chart with axes. The renderer derives a text alternative from the data automatically.

label.description: Optional heading for the feed, e.g. 'Incident timeline'.

items.description: The events, oldest first. Bind with {"path": ...} and append by rewriting the array — the feed grows without re-sending the component.

emptyText.description: Shown while the bound items array is empty. Quiet and factual.

Timeline.description: An event feed. Events are data, not components — the same philosophy as DataTable rows.

label.description: What the trend shows, e.g. 'p95 latency, last hour'. Required — it is the accessible name; the renderer also derives a text summary from the data.

values.description: The data points, raw numbers. Bind with {"path": ...} to stream new readings.

intent.description: Judgment of the trend on the shared scale. Default: 'neutral'.

Sparkline.description: An inline trend line with no axes — a word-sized chart for embedding beside stats and in prose-dense layouts.

label.description: What is progressing, e.g. 'Rolling out build 4191'. Required — it is the accessible name.

value.description: Current progress. OMIT this prop entirely for an indeterminate (unknown-duration) indicator. Bind with {"path": ...} so it advances via updateDataModel.

max.description: The value that means complete. May bind with {"path": ...} when the total itself can change (e.g. pods in a rollout).

intent.description: Judgment of the operation on the shared scale. Default: 'neutral'.

Progress.description: A determinate or indeterminate progress indicator. No value prop means indeterminate.

items.description: The facts. Each value may bind with {"path": ...} so single facts update live.

KeyValue.description: A definition list of labeled facts: metadata, configuration, the who/where/when of a thing.

code.description: The code or log text, verbatim. Bind with {"path": ...} to stream a growing log.

language.description: Syntax-highlighting hint, e.g. 'json', 'bash', 'log'. Free-form; the renderer highlights best-effort.

wrap.description: Soft-wrap long lines instead of horizontal scrolling.

label.description: Optional caption, e.g. a filename or 'deploy log'.

CodeBlock.description: Read-only code or log output with a built-in copy button. Never renders markup — text is shown verbatim.

label.description: The button text, naming the action, e.g. 'Abort rollout'.

confirmLabel.description: Text of the built-in second step, e.g. 'Really abort?'. Default is a localized 'Confirm?'.

action.description: Fired only after the confirm step. Context carries the action payload — what you need to act, nothing more.

intent.description: Judgment of the action on the shared scale — use 'bad' for destructive operations. Default: 'neutral'.

ConfirmButton.description: A button with a built-in confirm step for destructive or consequential actions. No modal, no round trip — the confirmation is part of the component.

$comment: $defs locally mirrors https://a2ui.org/specification/v1_0/common_types.json shapes so this file validates offline with ajv; the served copy may switch to absolute $refs.

key.description: Property name to read from each row object.

label.description: Column header. Required — it is the column's accessible name.

align.description: Logical alignment (RTL-safe). Numbers usually read best with 'end'.

format.description: How to interpret cell values: 'number' formats in the user's locale with tabular figures; 'datetime' expects an ISO 8601 string and renders it in the user's locale.

sortable.description: Enables client-side sorting on this column. No round trip.

label.description: Series name, shown in the legend and the generated text alternative.

values.description: The data points, raw numbers. Bind with {"path": ...} to stream new points.

time.description: When, as ISO 8601. The renderer formats it (absolute or relative) in the user's locale.

text.description: Optional detail line. Inline markdown allowed.

intent.description: Judgment of this event on the shared scale. Default: 'neutral'.

value.description: The fact, raw (string or number, or a {"path"} binding). Numbers and ISO dates are formatted in the user's locale.
